_about: The starting sounds, in this order; the first is the one the phone page opens on (main.ts, docs/design/phase2-12-presets.md). Each names a full patch, presets/<patch>.vital, built by tools/build_presets.mjs. Sig Wob 1-5 are tools/match.py --openl3's matches to each track's signature wob (phase4-03-pick.md); Ref Wob 1-6 are tools/match.py's matches to the references' wobs (phase4-02-matcher.md); the ten style presets of phase2-12 are no longer listed. Measured, not listened to: starting points for the producer to judge.
